name: Huge paper-cutout type slams the claim
looks: On the dark ground, a two-line claim slams in at a huge size, each letter carrying a thick offset drop-shadow like layered cut paper, the mark now small and orbiting one letter with a thin baseline rule beneath the whole line.
build: kinetic-word-run's hard-weighted entrance applied per line rather than per word, each letter's drop-shadow a duplicate layer offset a fixed few pixels down-right; the mark's orbit is a small circular path loop, independent of the text's own tween.
sound: A heavy slam hit as the type lands, with a lighter tick under the mark's orbit.
prompt: Land the film's biggest claim as oversized, paper-cutout type: a short two-line statement slams in at a huge size with a thick offset shadow on every letter, the brand's small recurring mark still visible, orbiting quietly beside it.
